data.name: Mayur I
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Mayur I has made a big mark in cricket. With 53 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 52*, with an average of 24.84 and a quick strike rate of 158.76. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 51 sixes and 46 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 127.0 overs, taking 56 wickets at an economy rate of 8.69. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
